name: Links For Israel
description: Authoritative open-source directory and machine-readable dataset for Israel and Jewish life — MOJ-verified nonprofits (data.gov.il, Section 46, US 501c3), 24/7 emergency & mental health hotlines, Aliyah & New Olim absorption, regulated money transfer providers, Masorti/Conservative & global Jewish heritage, volunteering, and citizen rights.

skills.name: Israeli 24/7 Emergency & Mental Health Hotlines
skills.description: Retrieve verified 24/7 crisis, medical, trauma, and civic hotlines in Israel (ERAN 1201, NATAL, 1202/1203, United Hatzalah 1221, Yedidim 1230, MOIA *2994, Pikud HaOref 104).

skills.name: MOJ-Verified Israeli Charities & Tax Deductibility
skills.description: Query Israeli nonprofits checked against Israel's Ministry of Justice (data.gov.il) for active status, Good Standing (Nihul Takin), Israeli Section 46, and US 501(c)(3).

skills.name: Aliyah, New Olim Rights & Regulated Money Transfers
skills.description: Find official Aliyah agencies, absorption NGOs, Lone Soldier centers, first-90-days rights, and clearly labeled licensed financial transfer services (ISA/FCA/FinCEN regulated).

skills.name: Judaism, Masorti/Conservative & Jewish Heritage
skills.description: Discover Conservative/Masorti Jewish institutions in Israel and worldwide, open Jewish libraries (Sefaria, Hebcal, 929), and lifecycle navigation (ITIM, Tzohar).
